108600369698450.title: Bottle of Last Breath
108600369698450.description: A bottle containing the last gasp of a dying person.

108639477585528.title: Tidebreaker
108639477585528.description:
Aquatic Mount
Level 11

120% Ground Speed
160% Water Speed
Underwater Breathing

109076218140352.title: Ode to Riverlands
109076218140352.description: Oh Riverlands, garden of Tishaba and refuge to me. You are an Ensemble of nature's best. Winds rustling the leaves near Serene pools. Gentle is the breeze that floats through Death's Moor. Flowing life into the gullet of Megalithic charm. Warming the fields of conflict yore. Oh Riverlands, garden of Tishaba you are a refuge to whispers galore.

109233986754172.title: Gold
109233986754172.description:
Gather: ALL 
Ingredient In: Metalworking, Weaponsmithing

6064628583103266825.title: Raven Rose
6064628583103266825.description: A deep red rose. It is known to only grow in graveyards.

sources.name: The stone piano key clicks into place. A small concealed drawer opens upon the gravestone. Inside is a scroll.

6064628860742664233.title: an ancient coin
6064628860742664233.description: an ancient type of money now defunct

6064629025932312675.title: Aryn's Journal
6064629025932312675.description: A journal filled with detailed case notes and travel logs. Given the circumstance, it feels rude to pry.

6064629064745943063.title: The Carna'Ultimo
6064629064745943063.description: This book is bound by goblin skin and  includes a number of chapters titled, Incantras.

6064629109597274198.title: Travellers Notes
6064629109597274198.description: This appears to be some form of cipher. The alphabet it uses is not familiar. Someone has jotted down a few translations.

6064629285432197200.title: Kyronic Shield
6064629285432197200.description: A ceremonial shield of the defunct Kyronic Order.

6064629286811533588.description: A shipment of well built tools

6064629286814941469.title: High Quality Tools
6064629286814941469.description: A shipment of master crafted tools.

6064629376459931658.title: Master Lumberjacking Axe
6064629376459931658.description: Chopping adolescent trees causes more durability loss.
more: Carefully crafted in a style of axe that tasted ghostbark, soulpine, and ironroot--ancient trees extinct in the present day, strangled by the corruption of the apocalypse.

6064629376678298060.title: Halo-Bound Aegis Hauberk
6064629376678298060.description: Said to tighten before judgment is passed, this hauberk bears the hush of long-dead sermons. It carries the weight of obedience, even when no command is spoken.

6064629376919732680.title: Sanctus Skulker Boots
6064629376919732680.description: Soft-soled and moss-stained, these boots hold the hush of rain in forest hollows. Step where they lead, and even the birds may forget to scatter.

6064629376920191660.title: Sanctus Skulker Grirdle
6064629376920191660.description: Tied with strands once soaked in river silt and moonlight, this girdle settles low and silent on the waist. Those who fasten it report a strange ease in vanishing between trees.

6064629376946406364.title: Riverstalker Mantle
6064629376946406364.description: Stirs faintly when names are spoken that should not be.

sources.name: A Magical Bag Of Mixed Goodies

6064629376965608488.title: Wolfen Maw
6064629376965608488.description: This fearsome helmet, cunningly fashioned from the skull of a huge wolf, evokes primal terror. Hollow eye sockets and gaping maw retain a chilling semblance of the beast's ferocious visage, to strike fear into the hearts of any who behold it.

6064629377026294870.title: Verdant Oath Longbow
6064629377026294870.description: Bound with vine and supple as a sapling, the Verdant Oath Longbow bends without sound and rights itself without strain. Its grip is always warm, and small insects gather near when it is still.

6064629449200631817.title: Ceremonial Dagger
6064629449200631817.description: The dagger is crafted of a black metal. It has the title "Goblin Slayer" on one side of the blade and "Brolin" on the opposite.

6064629721399296000.title: Corrupted Blood
6064629721399296000.description: Corrupted blood of those inflicted with Carphin's blood curse.

6064630140451946615.title: Novice Hunter's Shirt
6064630140451946615.description: Dyed in bark shades and stitched with waxed reed thread, this shirt clings like shadow to the torso.  It breathes with the forest and listens for prey better than its wearer does.

6064630140457058425.title: Apprentice Fisherman's Skivvies
6064630140457058425.description: Salt-crusted and river-soft, these pants dry fast and wear slow. Their cut favors patience and stillness.

6064630140767567999.title: Apprentice Armorsmith's Skivvies
6064630140767567999.description: These scorched trousers feel born of forge and fire, with heat-hardened panels at every strain point. They carry the sweat of invention and the promise of resilience.

6064630140788408457.title: Novice Scribe's Shirt
6064630140788408457.description: A modest garment worn by those just beginning to wrestle with the written word. It stains easily, breathes rarely, and remembers everything.

6064630140789588106.title: Journeyman Scribe's Tool Belt
6064630140789588106.description: This belt of dark leather patiently awaits inspiration. Its entire causa essendi is to the service of one who has moved beyond basic transcription and begun to record truths, treaties, and things not meant to be read aloud.

6064630140790898827.title: Apprentice Arcane Engineer's Skivvies
6064630140790898827.description: Gleaming threads woven through fireproof fabric hint at equations sewn into the seams. These pants move like thought and shield like theory.

6064630141136601236.title: Apprentice Alchemist's Skivvies
6064630141136601236.description: Crafted from breathable weave and toughened thread, these pants offer comfort without sacrificing utility. Deep, vial-sized pockets hint at a life lived between formulas and fire.

6064630141143154840.title: Novice Cook's Shirt
6064630141143154840.description: Short-sleeved and sharp-fitted, this garment breathes across steam and sear. A perfect piece for those who season with soul.

6064630141149184156.title: Journeyman Farmer's Tool Belt
6064630141149184156.description: Weatherproof and wide, this belt balances blades and bags with equal ease. It bears the rune of the Scion Korra, Patron of Farming and Agriculture.

6064630214427083132.title: Adventurer's Pants
6064630214427083132.description: These leggings remember the rhythm of travel better than most companions. They don't resist the journey. They request it.

6064630378753294336.title: Forager's Edge
6064630378753294336.description: Sharp-collared and speed-bound; your hands work faster just wearing this tunic.

6064630406148390932.title: Bear Carcass Portion
6064630406148390932.description:
Gather: Riverlands, Anvils 
Ingredient In: Tanning, Cooking

6064630406150029333.title: Gryphon Carcass Portion
6064630406150029333.description:
Gather: Riverlands 
Ingredient In: Tanning, Cooking, Alchemy

6064630407096172545.title: Belt of Fleet Harvest
6064630407096172545.description: Infused with haste-glyphs and windthistle. Rides tight on your hips and won't stop vibrating.

6064630417661886571.title: Spider Carapace
6064630417661886571.description:
Process: Tanning 
Ingredient In: Alchemy, Armorsmithing, Leatherworking

6064630417662017654.title: Wool Bolt
6064630417662017654.description:
Process: Weaving 
Ingredient In: Tailoring, Scribe, Leatherworking, Armorsmithing, Weaving

6064630417663000762.title: Brass Reinforced Caravan Chassis
6064630417663000762.description: Supports the structure and functionality of your caravan.

6064630417663918319.title: Duskwillow Earring
6064630417663918319.description: Twined from the roots of a willow that drank dusk for a hundred seasons, this piece bears the quiet resilience of floodplain survivors. It warms gently against the skin during storms.

6064631121051648034.title: Horse
more: Sinew and spirit in perfect rhythm, the Horse has long been the companion of warriors, wanderers, and kings. Its hooves drum like distant thunder across plains and stone, carrying its rider with speed, grace, and silent resolve. Though lacking the horns or claws of more fearsome beasts, few mounts rival its endurance or loyalty. Muscles ripple beneath a coat of wind-washed hair, and eyes gleam with quiet intelligence, ever alert to threat and command alike. It is not shaped by magic, but by trust and time, and in that lies its power.

6064632700246889316.title: Ebonthread Silk
6064632700246889316.description: A glossy black silk from Ebonthread Recluse spiders near the Sullied Tower. With its light-absorbing sheen and great strength, it is highly valued for its magical properties.

6064632700248986470.title: Old Tribal Bone Flute
6064632700248986470.description: An ancient Minotaur flute made from bone, smoothed by time. Etched with intricate carvings, it reflects the deep connection between land and people. The weathered hue gives it a timeless, sacred quality.

sources.name: T'kano has spent many years in communion with spirits, with ancestors. Fame he does not desire, nor power, but his bond with spirit world is deep, unbroken. He will know the path to purify the Horn, to cleanse its curse. T'kano's ways are hard, yet they are honest. He will aid you, but only if you approach with respect and clear purpose. Bring freshly cut flax as an offering, and take the bone flute I provide. It will show your heart, help him to see your intent.
Work with Wiyakoni remove the curse from the Horn of the Great Herd.

6064632750917156867.title: Perfect Pinion

Drop: Administrator Crucia 
Ingredient In: Arcane Engineering
more: Out of hundreds, this pinion feather is perfect. It's long, strong, and has a nice flex. The quill is firm, and the rachis is smooth and even. The barbs could not be more perfectly spaced, and it has a slight curve that makes it comfortable to hold.

6064632750946517001.title: Amulet of the Whispering Skull

6064632751605547008.description: A festive red hat trimmed with soft white fur and topped with a fluffy pom-pom. Infused with holiday cheer, wearing this hat boosts morale and might even grant a touch of seasonal luck. Perfect for spreading joy or mischief throughout Verra!

more: This small, leathery sac, harvested from a giant scorpion, pulses faintly with a toxic shimmer. Its contents are a potent, amber-hued venom capable of paralyzing prey or causing agonizing pain.

6064633012127072266.title: Lightclaw's Fetters
6064633012127072266.description: A crude necklace of rusted links and stolen gemstones, reeking of goblin craft. Used by Lightclaw captains to command their underlings, it hums with faint magic stolen from forbidden moon rituals.

6064633050307559426.title: Scorpix
more: Scorpix are a rare and monstrous breed of Scorpion said to be the direct spawn of Skla'risha, the Mother of Pain, a legendary predator that stalks the cursed core of the Sandsquall Desert. Larger than typical Scorpions and far more aggressive, Scorpix bear their mother's terrifying signature?a split tail tipped with twin venomous stingers. Their darkened carapace is thick as stone, and their blood-red eyes glow faintly in moonlight. Though notoriously difficult to tame, a trained Scorpix becomes a formidable mount, galloping over dunes with shocking speed and lashing out with brutal precision at any threat.

more: These tiny crimson blossoms of hot iron grow slowly on the outside of the Pyrespire Vents. Their natural shape resembles flowers, though once they're cut from the heat of the vent, they swiftly dull to grey.

6064633289697657042.title: Brine Briches
6064633289697657042.description: The Children of the Brine are a small cult operating within the Turquoise Sea. Devious and delusional, they believe an evil sea god will someday rise from the abyss to consume the world.

6064633289836528076.title: Fists of the Turik
6064633289836528076.description: The legendary Dunir, Captain Turik, was defeated by the pirate Threnody. Dragged to the abyss by a mysterious force, the great warship Seahammer fell, dragging with it mariners and Captain Turik, with cursing fists raised to the unreachable surface.

6064633289861759469.title: The Shield of Tura'Madu
6064633289861759469.description: During the Harbinger Apocalypse, the knights and war wolves of the reclusive Order of Tura'Madu came to the defense of villagers and refugees running from the demons of Golgora.

6064633408183205888.title: Novice Tempering Kit - Weapon
6064633408183205888.description:
A small, sturdy wooden box, polished to a soft sheen. Inside, nestled in compartments lined with dark velvet, are collected the required elements of magical enchantment. The lid is adorned with a small emblem, signifying the type of gear the kit is designed to enhance.
This kit can only be used on equipment of equal or lesser grade than itself; attempts to temper higher-tier gear are magically inhibited and cannot even be initiated.

6064633430591669398.description:

Ingredient In: Tailoring

6064633430599402659.title: Tresses of Aislinn

Ingredient In: Carpentry
more: Silken strands taken from the skull of an eternal archer, still whispering with ghostwind. Unbreakable, preternaturally taut, they sing when drawn - crying to guide arrows to the hearts of the soon-to-be forgotten.

6064633525797781512.title: Jundark Restored Treasure Map
6064633525797781512.description:
$TreasureMapInfo$
A weathered parchment map, marked with faded symbols and cryptic landmarks. The ink has worn in places, but the outline of an island and a distant mountain peak remain clear. Only the brave and clever can decode its secrets and embark on a perilous journey to uncover its riches.

6064633527216505312.title: Sparkveil Shoulders
6064633527216505312.description: Rest close to the body, shaped to turn aside a glancing blow while keeping the arms free for fast work.

6064633571793043458.title: Barrel of Fermented Plantain Beer
6064633571793043458.description:
Mild, slightly sour local brew made from plantains. Cheap, abundant, and a staple at Wildport taverns.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
more: Bottles of Coconut Oil

Pressed from wild coconuts along the coastal groves of Vandagar. This versatile oil has many uses, including cooking, salves, lanterns, and waterproofing sails.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Keg of Jundark Honey

Wild honey collected from towering canopy hives, prized for its smoky, floral flavors.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Jars of Ruinstar Dust

Sparkling dust collected from ancient stones embedded in Torren altars. When burned, it gives off vivid color plumes used in ceremonial incense and signal flares.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Case of Verdant Clay Bricks

Hand-shaped from the mineral-rich soil near the Mines of Madness. These greenish bricks harden like stone and are exported for building fortresses and estate walls.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Roll of Coarse Cotton Bolts

Rough jungle-grown cotton, unrefined but durable. Exported for use in rugged clothing, painters canvases, and weatherproof sails.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.

6064633578014311242.title: Midnight Gryphon
6064633578014311242.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: Shrouded in shadow and silence, the Midnight Gryphon glides through the darkness like a secret given form. Its wings, vast and velvet-black, drink the light from stars and lanterns alike, leaving only a whisper in its wake. The sleek muscles of its lion?s frame move with spectral grace, while its eyes gleam with a pale, cold fire that sees beyond illusion. Born beneath eclipsed moons and tempered in the hush of forgotten hours, the Midnight Gryphon is not merely a mount but a myth wrapped in feather and claw. It serves only the Mayor of Shorefoot, whose command must be as quiet as it is absolute, and whose presence must be felt even when unseen.

6064633605996871685.title: Wyrmling
6064633605996871685.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: Clad in bronze scales that shimmer like sunlit armor, the Wyrmling is the ember-born offspring of a militant legacy. Though small in stature, it carries the spirit of an ancient fire, coiled tight within a frame still learning its place in the skies. Its breath is smoke and promise, its eyes twin coals that burn with challenge and curiosity. Tempered by flame and ferocity, it yields to no hand that has not earned its trust through trial. Once bound, however, its loyalty is fierce and unshakable, a bond forged not by dominance, but by mutual will. The Mayor of Hecribba holds that bond, rising into the storm-laced heavens astride a creature that may yet grow into legend.

6064633776263463023.title: Statue of Tezcoatl
6064633776263463023.description: A statue portraying the Dendroan King, Tezcoatl in a serpent's coil. With twin red gems gleaming in its eyes, he appears regal, watchful, and poised to strike.

6064633776337846389.title: The Jundark Totem
6064633776337846389.description: A massive stone totem carved with the three creatures in the fable, "The Serpent and the Feather".

6064633783595761880.title: Ephemeral Caul
6064633783595761880.description: A gossamer shroud, thin as a memory and cool as cave-mist, it floats in the air, shimmering faintly with swirling hues. It flits about neither alive nor inert - bearing the faintest echo of a presence just departed. Fragments of luminous faces drift across its folds faster than the eye can follow. Laughing, crying, screaming.

6064633783596089561.title: Barbed Hobnail
6064633783596089561.description: Heavy in the hand and unnervingly warm, this twisted, iron-black spike is encircled with jagged barbs. Smoke-like veining radiates from each barb. Holding it is to feel a subtle burning, as if the metal itself resents even a moment's gentle touch, eager instead for the press of flesh, or something harsher.

6064633787069562882.title: Obsidian-Scaled Fish
6064633787069562882.description: A fish formed of obsidian scales. It's workmanship is exquisite, as its tailfin wiggles in hopes of some form of locomotion. It's very brittle and feels like it could disintegrate in your fingers.

6064633860906680336.title: Thornway Accord Sash
6064633860906680336.description: Coils in warning near tangled roots, though no threat can be named.

6064633860907139096.title: Oathdelve Grips
6064633860907139096.description: Creases form symbols not present at rest, most fade before they are read.

6064633860908187678.title: Tithebrook Trousers
6064633860908187678.description: Knees stiffen when approaching shrines, even if none are seen.

6064633860908646439.title: Hallowmark Trousers
6064633860908646439.description: Steps leave no sound, but something follows their rhythm.

6064633860909367342.title: Suncleft Choir Breastplate
6064633860909367342.description: This breastplate holds the weight of long-forgotten vows. Its inner lining is faintly scored with etchings said to align the breath and voice, as if the wearer were trained not only for battle, but for solemn recitation.

6064633860910350396.title: Starlight Creed Gauntlets
6064633860910350396.description: These gauntlets grip with the calm of sailors facing distant squalls, their silence drawn from nights when the stars vanished and the tide still obeyed.

6064633860910743618.title: Scorchwander Leggings
6064633860910743618.description: Layered for ease of movement across shifting dunes, these leggings hold the memory of long treks beneath mirrored skies. Each step seems lighter when the sun is at its harshest.

6064633860915921046.title: Cindermarch Gloves
6064633860915921046.description: Close with the surety of a craftsman's hold, ready for the hilt, the haft, or the draw of a bow.

6064633860916773030.title: Gritmantle Bracers
6064633860916773030.description: Hold firm at the forearms, their shape turning aside a strike as cleanly as a blade glances from dressed stone.

6064633860917166255.title: Veilrender Bracers
6064633860917166255.description: Slim and taut, made to vanish under shadow, with seams that disappear against the variegated greens and browns of the undergrowth.

6064633860917887158.title: Ferncloak Boots
6064633860917887158.description: Tread soft on moss and leaf litter, the soles finding sure hold even on the slick bark of a fallen log.

6064633860917887164.title: Ferncloak Helm
6064633860917887164.description: Shadows the brow while leaving the field of vision open, giving the gaze clarity from sunlit glade to shaded grove.

6064633860918411453.title: Slagwalker Cape
6064633860918411453.description: A heavy drape that still smells faintly of the forge, its edges scored with fine ash marks from the great smelters of the Anvils.

6064633860918411458.title: Slagwalker Pauldrons
6064633860918411458.description: Broad, sloped shoulders shaped to turn aside falling debris, their surfaces marked with old scoring from the workshop floor.

6064633860918739144.title: Wavebound Boots
6064633860918739144.description: Tread cut shallow and broad, made for the slick deck or wet stone, each step secure against the sudden lurch of the tide.

6064633860919525597.title: Gloomraider Shoulders
6064633860919525597.description: Set low and angled, their form turning aside the strike and slipping easily through narrow gaps in the foliage.

6064633860920312038.title: Wildmarch Shoulders
6064633860920312038.description: Broad enough to take the heft of a pack, their surface shaped to spill water rather than let it soak through.

6064633860920574191.title: Coalhewn Shoulders
6064633860920574191.description: Curve outward like the cut edge of quarried stone, their form made to deflect what comes from above or the side.

6064633860921491718.title: Duskhunter Jerkin
6064633860921491718.description: Cut for both guard and speed, its layered panels shift with the body whether pressing through dense vine or breaking into a run along a hidden trail.

6064633860947509545.title: Glenwarden Backplate
6064633860947509545.description: Shaped to mirror the arch of elder branches, this backplate bears scuffs where bark once grazed and briars tried to cling. The weight settles evenly, like a burden long accepted.

6064633860947509547.description: These boots remember the shape of overgrown trails and river-wet stone. Their tread is silent on rotwood and firm on forgotten steps.

6064633860950917454.title: Luminous Concord Breastplate
6064633860950917454.description: Smooth to the touch but heavy with silence, it holds the posture of those who knelt only once. The air thickens slightly when it faces an open hall.

6064633860950917456.title: Luminous Concord Vambraces
6064633860950917456.description: Wrap tight when near faultlines, though none can say whether the tension is warning or remembrance. They feel lighter after promises are kept.

6064633860983685549.title: Brineplate Greaves
6064633860983685549.description: Carry the steadfast weight of the seabed, lending each stride the unmovable resolve of stone shaped by centuries of waves.

6064633860984275385.title: Graveplate Cape
6064633860984275385.description: Hangs with the weight of rain-soaked canopy shadows, carrying the stillness of ancient barrows hidden where roots grow thicker than walls.

6064633860984275387.title: Graveplate Boots
6064633860984275387.description: Move with the measured tread of one who knows the ground may not be what it seems, their soles steady even on the treacherous loam of the Jundark.

6064633860984275393.title: Graveplate Faulds
6064633860984275393.description: Encircle the body's core with the layered protection of stone entombments, warding against the close and sudden dangers of the jungle's heart.

6064633860985061829.title: Ironwake Bracers
6064633860985061829.description: Guard the forearms with a smith's precision, locking the arms for both the strike and the shield's defense.

6064633860985717202.title: Coralhold Pauldrons
6064633860985717202.description: Rise like the towers of a coral citadel, shouldering the burden of command without bending to the weight.

6064633860986044884.title: Scaldplate Cape
6064633860986044884.description: It trails like the heat-haze over the horizon, the faint shimmer around its edges a reminder of the sun's unending hold over the desert.

6064633860986044886.title: Scaldplate Sabatons
6064633860986044886.description: Each step falls with the steadiness of one who has crossed dunes at midday, their tread unbroken by the shifting sand beneath.

6064633860988666370.title: Sandbastion Cuirass
6064633860988666370.description: Holds the chest in a fortress of its own making, each plate turned to face the heat and the sudden strike of steel without wavering.

6064633860989321746.title: Tombplate Faulds
6064633860989321746.description: Encircle the hips and waist with layered protection reminiscent of nested sarcophagi, each plate a barrier between the living and what lies beneath.

6064633860997710359.title: Emberwake Vestment
6064633860997710359.description: Carried across the high passes by those who swore to preserve the last flame, even when the forges fell cold.

6064633860998562342.title: Runebreath Trousers
6064633860998562342.description: Weighed not by fabric but by something older; the burden of meaning unspoken.

6064633860999086641.title: Ashwoke Sash
6064633860999086641.description: This belt bears faint burn rings where flame once tested its weave. Some say it still warms before danger.

6064633860999479865.title: Candlefen Treads
6064633860999479865.description: Carries no trace of where it's been, only where it should not return.

6064633861004132936.title: Ward of the Sevenfold Light Cape
6064633861004132936.description: Woven in silence within the high galleries of Duunhold, this mantle carries the shimmer of watchfires that burn in vaults unseen. It moves like breath through stone halls, veiling its bearer in the patient light of long memory.

6064633861004657227.title: Unfallen Rainment Spaulders
6064633861004657227.description: Patterned after the spiraling crests of island winds, these spaulders rest lightly, yet carry the quiet authority of tempests held at bay. Their edges shimmer faintly, as if still wet from the sea's embrace.

6064633861005247059.title: Shell of the Sanctifier Leggings
6064633861005247059.description: These leggings tread paths once marked by sun-priests and seekers alike. They remember each step not in distance, but in devotion.

6064633861010424487.title: Dustwhisper Jerkin
6064633861010424487.description: Light across the shoulders and chest, its weave made for long hours under the sun without slowing the body's pace.

6064633861010424491.title: Dustwhisper Cape
6064633861010424491.description: Falls in loose, muted folds that catch the wind only enough to blur the outline of the wearer, as if they are already part of the desert's haze.

6064633861010752176.title: Shadeweft Jerkin
6064633861010752176.description: Light and close-fitting, it moves with the body in a way that lets each breath blend with the stillness between the trees.

6064633861012259519.title: Glimmersoot Leggings
6064633861012259519.description: Cut for long strides through narrow corridors or along high ridgelines, their movement unhindered by weight.

6064633861012980441.title: Wraithskin Hood
6064633861012980441.description: Draws low, folding the head into the surrounding gloom until the face becomes only a deeper shade among many.

6064633861012980443.title: Wraithskin Pauldrons
6064633861012980443.description: Curve low to the frame, slipping past branches and thorns without leaving a mark.

6064633861012980448.title: Wraithskin Gloves
6064633861012980448.description: Close lightly around the fingers, the grip as controlled and cold as the jungle air before dawn.

6064633861013832425.title: Brightgrove Leggings
6064633861013832425.description: Move with the body whether crouched among ferns or leaping a narrow stream, their fit unbinding and fluid.

6064633861014029039.title: Ashveil Jerkin
6064633861014029039.description: Fits close to the body, its layered weave granting freedom of movement while carrying the subtle strength of tempered thread and careful craft.

6064633861014553346.title: Duneflare Boots
6064633861014553346.description: Step quickly across shifting sand, their soles finding quiet hold even on the steep face of a dune.

6064633861014881035.title: Nightwhisper Boots
6064633861014881035.description: Step without trace on wet loam and root, their tread quiet enough to pass unnoticed even in the listening dark.

6064633866777722913.title: Saltwoven Ring
6064633866777722913.description: Faintly bitter to the lips and light on the finger, it twists once at the scent of rainfall over stone. Some say it waits for the tide to turn.

6064633866777788450.title: Saltwoven Necklace
6064633866777788450.description: Bears the quiet pull of shifting tides and salt-heavy air. It steadies slightly when the sky forgets its color.

6064633866789191755.title: Shadebound Ring
6064633866789191755.description: Cut to swallow the stray glint, this sliver sits quiet as water under canopy, more absence than adornment until it moves.

6064633867061952612.title: Sunscorch Axe
6064633867061952612.description: Matte planes shed glare even at noon, the lines cut lean for work where sand runs quick underfoot.

6064633867063525482.title: Nightreaver Axe
6064633867063525482.description: Darkened steel with a river-run curve, meant for work between tangled roots where echoes do not return.

6064633867081547894.title: Stoneforge Great Axe
6064633867081547894.description: Cut from slab-forged billets and weight-balanced on a granite plinth, the Stoneforge Great Axe answers only to steady hands. It does not glint or gleam, but strikes clean and true, like truth carved in stone.

6064633867101339800.title: Stoneforge Spell Book
6064633867101339800.description: Solid in hand and resistant to time, the Stoneforge Spell Book opens with a creak like shifting rock. Its contents are etched deep and straight, though some pages bear marks not made by any known quill.

6064633867113005218.title: Flameheart Great Grimoire
6064633867113005218.description: Margins glow with kiln toned pigments, each initial cooling to a calm shine as if fresh from temper.

6064633867116609708.title: Glassveil Great Grimoire
6064633867116609708.description: Fine grit glints along the spine, and lines waver to a mirage shimmer before settling into clarity.

6064633867179196635.title: Nightreaver Focus
6064633867179196635.description: Darkened surface reflects only the faintest glimmer, like a moon hidden in cloud.

6064633867197874424.title: Ironhearth Mace
6064633867197874424.description: The Ironhearth Mace hits with deliberate finality, as if the blow had already been decided. Sparks sometimes leap from stone when it lands, even in darkness.

6064633867199578365.title: Sandcarved Mace
6064633867199578365.description: Worn smooth by wandering winds, its shape remembers trials faced beneath a colorless sun.

6064633867204296972.title: Deepweld Mace
6064633867204296972.description: Forged with a calm weight, its finish bears the quiet permanence of deep stone.

6064633867216552230.title: Sunscorch Great Mace
6064633867216552230.description: Flat facets keep the eye clear though heat dances across the world.

6064633867217862956.title: Nightreaver Great Mace
6064633867217862956.description: Low shine surfaces that refuse the moon, all purpose kept in shadow.

6064633867218977073.title: Dreadwake Great Mace
6064633867218977073.description: Its mass moves with the pull of dark water, silent and certain.

6064633867236933978.title: Runeweld Scepter
6064633867236933978.description: The Runeweld Scepter is etched with fading lines that rearrange when unseen. It pulses faintly near old ruins and draws a circle of stillness in loud places.

6064633867250172286.title: Shadowfang Shield
6064633867250172286.description: Edges soften to deny a glint, the whole shape made to move like shadow across stone.

6064633867254235528.title: Mistwood Shortbow
6064633867254235528.description: Slender and silent, the Mistwood Shortbow vanishes easily into undergrowth. It creaks only when drawn in full sun and never leaves a mark on the hand.

6064633867254366601.title: Stoneforge Shortbow
6064633867254366601.description: Chiseled more than carved, the Stoneforge Shortbow holds its arc without strain. Its draw is smooth but deliberate, and each arrow lands with the weight of settled stone.

6064633867259675038.title: Dreadwake Shortbow
6064633867259675038.description: Dark limbs with river smooth finish, the curve hard to see until it moves.

6064633867266818476.title: Seabright Spear
6064633867266818476.description: It glistens faintly, like wet stone pulled from the tidepools of Turquoise shores.

6064633867267146157.title: Sunscorch Spear
6064633867267146157.description: Dry heat seems to rise from its shaft, as though it remembers the endless desert wind.

6064633867270160819.title: Sunfire Spear
6064633867270160819.description: The Riverlands' noon warmth seems trapped in the grain of its polished length.

6064633867283595740.title: Stoneforge Greatsword
6064633867283595740.description: Hewn with precision and balanced like a plumb line, the Stoneforge Greatsword lands with the weight of a carved truth. Its edge stays clean, and it hums faintly when held in silence.

6064633867288707567.title: Sunscorch Greatsword
6064633867288707567.description: Its surface holds the glare of a sun at zenith, harsh enough to blind the unwary. The grip is warm, as though it remembers the forge's final breath.

6064633867294867969.title: Shadowfang Wand
6064633867294867969.description: Dark ridges spiral along its shaft, hinting at a waiting bite. The space around it feels colder.

6064633867295195650.title: Pyrebrand Wand
6064633867295195650.description: A slow ember glows in its core, steady and patient. The wood smells faintly of char.

6064633895599538177.title: Mount Cosmetic: Midnight Mare
6064633895599538177.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Cloaked in velvety shadow and gleaming like obsidian under moonlight, the Midnight Mare is a steed bred for the quiet hours. It moves with uncanny silence, its hooves scarcely making a sound as it glides across the earth like a living whisper. Though calm in manner, there is a chill in the air when it passes, as if the night itself rides with it. Many believe the mare draws power from the moon above, growing faster and more elusive as dusk deepens. A favorite among silent riders and shadowy messengers, it is as unsettling as it is elegant. This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895604453382.title: Mount Cosmetic: Moonstrider
6064633895604453382.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Towering and tranquil, the Moonstrider is bred for burdens and born to wander. Its elongated limbs and reflective coat give it an almost spectral presence on the road, glowing softly beneath the stars. Travelers prize it not for speed, but for stamina and surefooted grace across rugged terrain. When coaxed into motion, it surprises many with a smooth and steady gait that seems to glide over rock and root alike. Though solitary by nature, it forms a strong bond with patient riders and has become a trusted companion on long, lonesome journeys. This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895628963862.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895669006370.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895700463670.title: Mount Cosmetic: Stag of the Boughs
6064633895700463670.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Crowned in tangled antlers and cloaked in living moss, the Stag of the Boughs is a mount drawn from the heart of Verra?s oldest forests. Each step stirs leaf and soil, and many claim it communes with the glens it guards. Riding one is said to earn the favor of woodland spirits.

6064633895710752828.title: Mount Cosmetic: Prowler of Perdition
6064633895710752828.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Clad in shadow and crowned with malevolence, the Prowler of Perdition is a mount drawn from nightmare. Whispers follow in its wake, and its presence alone unsettles even the boldest foes. Once believed to be omens of ruin, these fearsome beasts now serve those brave or foolish enough to ride what others flee. They do not gallop so much as glide, as if the earth recoils beneath their stride.

6064633895754661971.title: Mount Cosmetic: Amethyst Boughbite
6064633895754661971.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: With limbs like carved marble and a shell that glimmers in shades of violet and gold, the Amethyst Boughbite strides with noble confidence. Its tall frame and crested crown once marked it as a symbol of royal authority, often seen leading ceremonial marches or charging into the fray beside elite guards. Though its appearance is elegant, its armored hide and natural defenses make it more than just a creature of pageantry. To ride a Boughbite is to carry the legacy of those who ruled with strength and stood unshaken in the face of chaos.

6064633895793131625.title: Mount Cosmetic: Twilight Courser
6064633895793131625.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Drifting like mist beneath the stars, the Twilight Courser is a mount cloaked in the hush of dusk. Its movements are fluid and quiet, its presence subtle yet captivating. Travelers claim it appears at the hour when day gives way to night, guiding riders through the liminal veil with ghostly grace.

6064633895804338289.title: Mount Cosmetic: Felgaz Stalker
6064633895804338289.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: With eyes that burn like coals and a body that moves like mist along forgotten paths, the Felgaz Stalker is a mount born of shadow and silence. It slips through dense forests and shattered ruins with uncanny ease, its steps leaving no sound and little sign. Said to dwell near the thinning places between worlds, it carries riders who value speed, subtlety, and the thrill of the unknown. To ride a Felgaz is to vanish into the dark and reappear where none expect you.

6064633895804534898.title: Cosmetic: Adolescent Galestalker
6064633895804534898.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895835402375.title: Mount Cosmetic: Saberfang Hauler
6064633895835402375.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: With shoulders like boulders and tusks curved like scimitars, the Saberfang Hauler is a living engine of burden and brawn. Originally bred for pulling siege equipment across broken terrain, it now serves those whose loads would crush lesser beasts. Despite its intimidating presence, it bonds fiercely with patient handlers, responding best to quiet strength over loud command.

6064633895848247439.title: Mount Cosmetic: Silkfur Dunehunter
6064633895848247439.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: This elusive desert mount moves like a mirage, its shimmering coat blending into the heat-haze of the dunes. With paws soft as whispering wind and senses honed to survive the harshest sands, the Silkfur Dunehunter is the choice of scouts, smugglers, and those who favor speed over steel.

6064634099034882053.title: Tidesnapper
6064634099034882053.description:
Aquatic Mount
Level 11

200% Water Speed
Underwater Breathing
more: With a low-slung shell streaked in salt and seafoam, the Tidesnapper moves like a shadow beneath the waves. When danger nears, it bursts forth with shocking speed, jaws snapping shut with a crack like splintering wood. A stealthy and sudden mount for those who ride the tides.

6064634139002798126.title: Rugged Fur Pelt
6064634139002798126.description: A coarse, thick pelt from an Anvils bear. Its rugged fur provides basic warmth and protection, suitable for travelers and hunters braving the harsh winter.

6064634205607493693.title: Rune-carved Gemstone
6064634205607493693.description: A large and heavy gem that has been crudely etched with many odd runes.

sources.name:
Take this gem to Sanvi, her intuition is better than mine. We've recovered dozens of them from the Ramkin in the caverns.
I'm sure there's a connection between all of these elements, but I'm just not seeing it yet?

6064634415251128352.title: Shards of a Broken Lens
6064634415251128352.description: The edges are sharp and jagged, as though the lens cracked under immense pressure. Touching the shard is unsettling, as though the pieces are trying to return to where it belongs.
more: These pieces fit together into a whole.

6064634489922977794.title: Tomebreaker
6064634489922977794.description: This weapon's head is cracked and uneven, like a collapsed tower of thought. Each blow it delivers lands with the finality of a forgotten truth. The haft bears shallow rings, worn smooth by the passage of uncounted hands, and at its base, a broken clasp swings like a lost key to memory. The sigil of The Twins: Qluud & Qtorum, vaguely resembling an hourglass, is carved into its head. It is a weapon that does not just crush the body of an enemy; it obliterates the conviction that held that body upright.

6064634518667526284.title: Girdings of the Twelve-Hour Fall
6064634518667526284.description: Dense and immovable, these plates echo faintly when struck, as though falling through air that no longer remembers how to resist. Their joints are locked with overlapping symbols, each representing a fraction of descent. On the outer thigh, a broken dial rests beneath a cracked window that measures, not time, but distance between regrets.

6064634597678252032.title: Remembrance Severed
6064634597678252032.description: This greatsword was not forged ? it was forgotten into being. Its blade bears a jagged edge, cracked like the fracture lines of a sundered oath. Ghostly impressions of names once etched into the fuller have long since been worn smooth, but the weight of those erased still anchors every swing. It moves with an unnatural silence. Not stealth, but mourning made mute.

6064634618854637615.title: Carpenter's Shirt
6064634618854637615.description: Woven strong and cut for motion, this shirt bears the smell of cedar and sweat. Its seams follow the rhythm of timber raised.

6064634618857455664.title: Arcane Engineer's Skivvies
6064634618857455664.description: Gleaming threads woven through fireproof fabric hint at equations sewn into the seams. These pants move like thought and shield like theory.

6064634618883866682.title: Scribe's Leggings
6064634618883866682.description: Scholarly leggings designed not for appearances, but for long hours of ink-stained stillness and quiet communion with the written word. They fray easily, but never complain. Much like their wearer.

6064634618891206717.title: Miner's Shirt
6064634618891206717.description: Made from threaded canvas and sweat-hardened seams, this shirt hangs heavy even before its first shift. You won't notice how much it protects--until the day you forget to wear it.

6064634618915651653.title: Hunter's Shirt
6064634618915651653.description: Dyed in bark shades and stitched with waxed reed thread, this shirt clings like shadow to the torso.  It breathes with the forest and listens for prey better than its wearer does.

6064634618923647049.title: Metalworker's Shirt
6064634618923647049.description: The back panel is looser than the front, not for comfort, but for the arch of a hammer swing. If it doesn't pull when you strike, you're doing it wrong.

6064634618934722638.title: Tanner's Skivvies
6064634618934722638.description: A rugged and unceremonious base layer, worn by those who work elbow-deep in alchemical brine, hide-stink, and the slow, sacred art of softening death into something useful.

6064634619020902493.title: Processor's Shirt Box
more: A shirt to start you on your first steps into processing materials!

6064634654088298615.title: Lost Gloves
6064634654088298615.description: Grip your fate with the strength to forge forward.

6064634654088298629.title: Wanderguard Sabatons
6064634654088298629.description: Dust of travels cling to the your soles.

6064634654088298636.title: Lost Scepter
6064634654088298636.description: A lost weapon, but not nearly as lost as you.

6064634654436688046.title: Lost Soul Faulds
6064634654436688046.description: Forged for flexibility and defense against those who stood between the quest for knowledge and the chaos that sought to consume it.

6064634654436688052.title: Wayward Sword
6064634654436688052.description: The lands call to those that wish to find what was lost. May this weapon guide your way.

6064634716623476594.description: Grants a set of gear and weapons.

6064634762078322698.title: Drainspider's Whisper Loop
6064634762078322698.description: This small relic was spun from the Gilded Drain?s hungry dark, holding a faint tremor of webbed patience. It makes silence feel attentive, as if something below the stones listens for the next careless footfall.

6064634762086121517.title: Foundry Ashmantle
6064634762086121517.description: Shoulders stained by the Foundry Gate?s last breath, these guards keep the warmth of a dead furnace without heat. Their runes speak of craft as devotion, and they settle on the wearer like a silent vow to rebuild what was lost.

6064634762098769987.title: Unmaker?s Bracelets
6064634762098769987.description: These forearm wraps were made for hands that dismantled more than they forged. Their woven sigils hum with careful undoing, guiding motion toward weak seams and hidden latches, the quiet art of ending a thing cleanly.

6064634765654294528.title: Wanderer's Shield
6064634765654294528.description: You will face much conflict as you wander, but with proper protection you will never be delayed long.

6064634765822853386.title: Thundering Bolt Beast
6064634765822853386.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
1000% Maximum Health
more: Born from the breath of tempests and the wrath of shattered skies, the Thundering Bolt Beast is lightning made flesh, a force of nature bound only by will and woven legend. Its body pulses with crackling veins of raw energy, each thunderous step splitting the air and searing the ground with arcs of stormfire. Where it walks, the wind bows and the earth remembers. Tales whisper of an age when the heavens waged war upon themselves and flocks of Bolt Beasts circled the maelstroms like living sigils of judgment, their cries echoing across creation. Though their kind has all but vanished into the clouds that birthed them, the fiercest storms still call to them, and one has answered to Windansea. The Mayor alone rides this elemental fury, chosen not by conquest, but by the storm's own recognition of a soul forged in chaos and crowned in command.

6064634822505529344.title: Cosmetic: Mantle of the Moment
6064634822505529344.description: Applies cosmetic appearance to your equipped Cloak.
more: Sanctus scholars describe a convergence where causality awaits a response that never comes. When a ritual, gateway, or construct fails to resolve, those who endure are known as The Voiv.
